mentions.name: functional-emotions
mentions.description: A Claude Code plugin that adds hooks to inject "baselines" under certain conditions, counteracting "emotions" that can cause subtle misaligned behavior in AI agents; based on ideas from Anthropic research on emotion concepts and function.
mentions.problem: Certain "emotions" can cause subtle misaligned behavior in AI agents.
mentions.source_excerpt:
2) Claude code plugin based on some ideas found in https://www.anthropic.com/research/emotion-concepts-function
The main idea is to add hooks that inject “baselines” under some conditions to counteract certain “emotions” that can cause subtle misaligned behavior in agents
